caption:
Figure 1. We propose CrossSDF, a novel approach for reconstructing a 3D signed-distance field from 2D cross-sections. The input is a
set of 2D cross-sections that sample an unobserved ground-truth geometric object by planar intersection (denoted as black lines overlayed
on the ground truth Alveolis structure on the left). CrossSDF (middle) accurately reconstructs thin structures without breakages, over-
smoothing, or cross-sectional artifacts observed in competing methods (right).
